changes.behavior: Reusable fixed-capacity Uint32 selections; builds comma signatures only on exact ordered selection changes. All world-bound distances, detail/LOD hysteresis, frustum and shadow decisions remain live every frame.

Persistent per-cascade entries with frame marks replace per-frame clear/refill allocation. Still scans every current caster signature and removes absent casters on the next scanned cascade; skipped cascades retain the same previous state as before.
